# `product_offering_qualification`

Area: **ordering** ([all tables](README.md))

A TMF679 product offering qualification as answered: a check (can this account get these offerings, with this device, number and address?) or a query (which offerings can it get?). Synchronous, a dry run of the order engine; deleted by housekeeping 30 days after creation.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `kind` | `text` | no |  | check (checkProductOfferingQualification) or query (queryProductOfferingQualification). |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The billing account qualified (from the items or the search criteria). No foreign key: it never blocks deleting the account. |
| `state` | `text` | no |  | TMF679 TaskStateType; always done: every qualification is answered synchronously. |
| `qualification_result` | `text` | yes |  | A check: qualified when every item is, else unqualified. NULL for a query. |
| `qualification_date` | `date` | no |  | The BILLING_TZ day the items were qualified for (an order placed that day). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `expires_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | expirationDate: the end of the qualification day; prices, funds and numbers move after it. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `items` | `jsonb` | no |  | checkProductOfferingQualificationItem or qualifiedProductOfferingItem, as answered. |
| `details` | `jsonb` | no | `'{}'::jsonb` | What the client sent that has no behaviour, as sent: description, channel, note, relatedParty, requestedQualificationCompletionDate, the provide* flags and a query's searchCriteria. |
| `base_type` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `schema_location` | `text` | yes |  |  |
